title: Fresh-session blank form wholesale-replaces a rich prior draft with empty-string values (empty-map guard never fires)
evidence:
serializeForm emits EVERY non-skipped control, untouched ones as "":
      var value =
        type === "checkbox"
          ? el.value || "on"
          : String(el.value == null ? "" : el.value);
      fields[name] = value;
The server guard only rejects a literally empty map (draft_handler.gleam):
                [] -> wisp.json_response(json_ok(True), 200)
and the upsert replaces wholesale (upsert_application_draft.sql):
ON CONFLICT (vacancy_id, email) DO UPDATE
  SET fields = EXCLUDED.fields,
The integration pin covers only fields:{} (empty_fields_save_never_wipes_a_draft_test sends json.object([])).
detail: Returning applicant who saved on day 1 (no link requested) reopens the blank form, enters only their email, then changes step or clicks 'Email me a link': the payload is ~40 keys of '' values, passes the non-empty guard, and deterministically wipes the previous session's answers; the emailed link now restores blanks.
recommended_fix: Server: skip the upsert when an existing live draft has content and every incoming value is '' (or merge per-key, empty never overwriting non-empty); add an integration test with blank-string values, mirroring the real serializer output.

title: Vacancy closing mid-session disables the saver but leaves the save-and-continue promise and a deterministically-failing continue button
detail: New round-2 fix code (closed-arm) sets saverDisabled but reconciles no UI: the prep note keeps promising 'your answers save as you go', and the injected button keeps answering 'Couldn't send the link just now… Try again in a moment' though every retry deterministically fails.
recommended_fix: In the closed arm, revert the prep note to the SSR one-visit line and disable (or relabel) the continue button/status so the terminal state stops promising retries.

title: Client-plausible but server-invalid email: saves 400 silently forever and continue-link misreports a deterministic rejection as transient
detail: For such emails every debounced save gets a 400, is never acknowledged, and the draft never persists with zero signal; the continue click shows 'Couldn't send the link just now… Try again in a moment' when retrying deterministically fails — nothing points at the email as the blocker.
recommended_fix: Treat a 400 on save/continue as terminal-invalid-email: surface the needs-email style guidance (check the address) instead of the transient-failure copy, or align the client regex with shared/email.is_valid.
